title: angelica dieffenbachii
intro: Angelica dieffenbachii, commonly known as Yuchi angelica, is a species of flowering plant in the carrot family native to China. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Angelica dieffenbachii include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
